notes.title: Covenant: Project Zero Achievements Update
notes.notes:
[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS ARE LIVE!!![/h1]

As we announced in Devlog 12, we've been hard at work to get all the achievements setup. We wanted to make sure we do it right, so you can really dig into the game and try and get that elusive 100%!!!

Have fun everyone, adventure awaits!

Thank you for playing [b]Covenant: Project Zero[/b]!

[i]The Team @ DENT Studios[/i]

notes.title: COVENANT: PROJECT ZERO RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[h1]9 JUNE 2023 | 12 PM CET[/h1]

[previewyoutube=Y-i_JE97q-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't seen the release announcement trailer already - please do!

After a few years of developing our first arcade adventure for Steam PC & Mac, we feel we have a good, if somewhat niche game ready for you to play!

There was a lot of first's on this one.

[i][b]First time we build a world.[/b][/I]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250841/f70b3bf00fcb2f72e6214ca686971c8e4d7fb08d.png[/img]

First time we wrote a story, and then some more story, and then a [b]whole lot more[/b] story. And then rewrote it.. Like... Seven hundred times at least. From scratch....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250841/dea1b4969a49fd60ced77678c83f31a414dfd588.png[/img]

First time our most of our devs made a game that's actually going to be released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250841/0ccf6982ae2a6773d4fe3922bccef850e6dfab17.png[/img]

[b]But more then anything - first time we made something BIG, something this entire big little team will be proud of! Indeed - you never forget your first indie game![/b]

So please have fun playing our game! We'll listen to your feedback on the Steam game community forum, so please write!

The stage is set, the actors are ready to read their lines for you. Enjoy the experience, and, of course - remember to load up on batteries! ːsteamhappyː You'll definitely need them!

Thank you all for the wishlists and for playing our game from the entire team behind [b]Covenant: Project Zero[/b]
